question: Eid-ul-Fitr is celebrated on the first day of which of the following Islamic months?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shawwal.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Eid-ul-Fitri **is one of the major festivals of **Muslims.**
 
• **Eid-ul-Fitr is celebrated on the first day of Shawwal**, the **10th Month of the Islamic Calander.**
 
• **Muslims** follow a **Lunar Calander** Where a **year is 11 days shorter than the Solar year.**
 
• **Eid-ul-Fitr **is also called the **festival of breaking the fast.**
 
• **Eid-ul-Fitr** is celebrated after the end of the **Holy month of Ramadan.**
